blocks.text: Optimize your Chrome workspace for recruiting

Your browser is your most used tool. If you are not using profiles, you are losing time. Create separate Chrome profiles for different clients or internal teams. Go to the profile icon in the top right, click Add, and set up a new space. This keeps your bookmarks and extensions organized by project. It prevents cross-contamination of candidate data.

items: ⌘ + T: Open a new tab for a fresh search.
⌘ + L: Jump to the address bar immediately.
⌘ + Shift + T: Reopen a closed tab if you accidentally lose a resume.
⌘ + 1 to 8: Switch between your open tabs for different candidates.
Control + Tab: Move to the next tab to the right.

blocks.text: Handle the administrative tax with Lazur

Recruiters lose hours to scheduling and data entry. You can ask Lazur to help you manage these tasks. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on your screen. If you are stuck in a complex ATS interface, ask Lazur where a button is. It will draw a circle around it for you.

Stop typing out long feedback notes after every call. Hold the fn key to dictate directly into your ATS or Notion. Speak clearly and use your own shorthand. Lazur formats the text for you. This is faster than manual entry and keeps your candidate records accurate.
Use the fn key for dictation to keep your hands on the keyboard. It works in any text field, including LinkedIn messages and email drafts.
blocks.title: Pro tip for dictation

blocks.text: Too many tabs slow down your focus. Use [How to create a chrome profile on mac](/how-to/create-a-chrome-profile-in-chrome) to group related work. If you find yourself with fifty tabs open, use the tab search feature. Press ⌘ + Shift + A to see a list of all open tabs. You can search for a candidate name to find their tab instantly.

Sometimes sites stop loading or show errors. Before you panic, try to [How to clear site data for one website in chrome](/how-to/clear-site-data-for-one-website-in-chrome). This fixes many issues without logging you out of every site. If that fails, check your extensions. Go to Menu > Extensions > Manage Extensions and disable ones you do not recognize.

Privacy is vital when handling resumes. Always check your site settings. You can [How to block third-party cookies in chrome](/how-to/block-third-party-cookies-in-chrome) to prevent tracking. This is a good habit for recruiters who visit many different job boards and candidate portfolios.

faq.question: How can Lazur help me as a technical recruiter?
faq.answer: Lazur helps you manage your Mac workflow by answering questions, pointing at UI elements, and dictating text. It reduces the time spent on manual administrative tasks by letting you use voice commands for common actions.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside my ATS?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your Mac screen. It can point at buttons in your ATS or help you dictate notes into any text field, but it does not click buttons or interact directly with the software.

faq.question: What is the best way to organize Chrome for recruiting?
faq.answer: Use Chrome profiles to separate different clients or hiring pipelines. Each profile keeps its own bookmarks, history, and extensions, which helps you stay focused on one set of candidates at a time.

faq.question: How do I fix Chrome if it runs slowly?
faq.answer: Check your extensions list and remove anything you do not use. You can also clear your site data for specific sites if they become unresponsive. Keeping your browser updated to the latest version is also essential.
